answer: Audits are recorded in grove, queued in willow, and sable publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 75 identities per epoch. A farm of 145 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2937 identities would post 774 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
